{{Conjecture|legends}}
The [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Larry]] lived in a '''tribe''' on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. When Larry was a [[Youngling/Legends|child]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] ran away from his home, saying that it would take "a million [[Munyip/Legends|munyips]] to drag him back." Larry returned several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later,<ref name="Home is Where the Shrieks Are">{{Ewoks|Home Is Where the Shrieks Are}}</ref> by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="EwoksDate">{{EwoksDate|mention of [[Larry]]'s community|[[Home Is Where the Shrieks Are|Home is Where the Shrieks Are]]}}</ref> and he discovered that everyone in the community had relocated without him.<ref name="Home is Where the Shrieks Are" />

==Behind the scenes==
The community was mentioned in "[[Home Is Where the Shrieks Are|Home is Where the Shrieks Are]],"<ref name="Home is Where the Shrieks Are" /> the third episode in the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]. The episode was written by [[Bob Carrau]], and it premiered on [[September 20]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider 27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
